subject: [PATCH v3 01/12] mm/khugepaged: drop redundant mm_struct pin in madvise_collapse()

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Approved the patch with Acked-by, indicating that it looks good to them and they're willing to vouch for its quality.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch series aims to optimize the khugepaged functionality by dropping redundant mm_struct pinning in madvise_collapse(). The optimization involves removing unnecessary mmgrab() and mmdrop() calls, which are already handled by other callers. This change is expected to improve performance and reduce memory usage.
